title: mri_surfcluster
description: A tool for clustering vertices on a cortical surface based on intensity values.

output_surface_file.description: Filtered surface file with non-cluster vertices set to 0

output_cluster_number_file.description: Surface file with cluster number per vertex

output_summary_file.description: Text summary file of clustering results

output_pointset_file.description: Pointset file for visualization in Freeview

output_max_area_file.description: File containing the area of the largest cluster
